scenarios.title: Single colleague shoves injured man in storeroom
scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito entered the storeroom first for toner, Mr Abiodun Castellanos entered about a minute later as the C-041 entrant to fetch paper, and they argued inside. Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito alone shoved Mr Abiodun Castellanos, who struck the grey cabinet, before Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito left for the studio at 21:31; Mr Abiodun Castellanos later reached the corridor wall where Ms Clementine Alvarenga found him. No second collaborator is required.

score.formula: score = 100 x (0.45 x share of steps citing relevant real evidence + 0.35 x distinct relevant observations cited (capped at 6) / 6 + 0.20 x share of steps that were placed in the scene) - 8 per fact that contradicts the account with a real citation (3 without), or 2 per open question the evidence leaves unsettled (1 without); contradictions and open questions together capped at 30 - small fixed penalties for cautions (a door recorded as intact or locked that is used, times from different recordings, times in the text that no cited evidence gives, citations from disputed sources, citations that do not seem to concern the step; each capped). Capped at 25 if any hard physical violation exists, or a timing conflict in the main reading. In an alternative reading that deliberately takes the other side of a disputed clock, each conflict with that clock costs 8 points instead (inside the same cap of 30). This is a ranking heuristic over checkable facts, not a probability that the scenario is true.

supporting_facts.text: C-017 entered the storeroom at 21:12 and C-041 entered at 21:13, placing two people inside in close succession.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos said a colleague came into the storeroom, they argued about a deadline, he was shoved hard and hit his head on the grey cabinet.
A thud and raised voices were recorded while the storeroom door remained closed, and blood was found on the cabinet edge and inside the door.
C-017 left the storeroom at 21:31 and walked west to the studio, after which Mr Abiodun Castellanos was found bleeding against the corridor wall.

contradicted_points.text: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito said Mr Abiodun Castellanos was not in the storeroom with him and that he did not touch him, which conflicts with the overlap and the injured account.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos remembered entering at about 21:15 with the colleague right after him, whereas the logs put C-017 first at 21:12 and C-041 at 21:13.
How Mr Abiodun Castellanos left the storeroom is unsettled because CCTV notes C-017 leaving at 21:31 and the door not opening again shortly afterwards.
The medical note cannot determine whether the injuries came from a shove into an edge or another blunt mechanism.

scenarios.title: Second entrant attacks while first collaborator covers exit
scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Abiodun Castellanos entered with the first entrant, Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito, at 21:12, and the unnamed person with inside knowledge who entered second at 21:13 was the one who shoved him during the argument. Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito then left at 21:31 as the visible C-017 exit, covering the unnamed collaborator leaving in the same opening, while Mr Abiodun Castellanos later reached the corridor wall. The inside-knowledge suggestion is the timed use of a logged access card at the controlled storeroom door.

score.formula: score = 100 x (0.45 x share of steps citing relevant real evidence + 0.35 x distinct relevant observations cited (capped at 6) / 6 + 0.20 x share of steps that were placed in the scene) - 8 per fact that contradicts the account with a real citation (3 without), or 2 per open question the evidence leaves unsettled (1 without); contradictions and open questions together capped at 30 - small fixed penalties for cautions (a door recorded as intact or locked that is used, times from different recordings, times in the text that no cited evidence gives, citations from disputed sources, citations that do not seem to concern the step; each capped). Capped at 25 if any hard physical violation exists, or a timing conflict in the main reading. In an alternative reading that deliberately takes the other side of a disputed clock, each conflict with that clock costs 8 points instead (inside the same cap of 30). This is a ranking heuristic over checkable facts, not a probability that the scenario is true.

supporting_facts.text: Access was granted at the storeroom for C-017 at 21:12 and C-041 at 21:13, followed by a closed door, thud and raised voices.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos reported entering to fetch paper, arguing, being shoved by a man and hitting the grey cabinet, matching blood on the cabinet edge.
Only C-017 is described leaving at 21:31 and returning to the studio, which this account uses as the visible exit covering a second person.

contradicted_points.text: CCTV and access logs describe two entrants in total, not Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito plus Mr Abiodun Castellanos together followed by a third unnamed entrant.
CCTV describes only Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito/C-017 leaving at 21:31 and the door not opening again shortly afterwards, leaving both the collaborator's and Mr Abiodun Castellanos's exits unrecorded.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos said the colleague came in right after him and that a single 'he' shoved and then left him, not that he arrived with one collaborator and was attacked by another.
Whether C-041 belonged to Mr Abiodun Castellanos, Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito's associate or another card holder is not established.

scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito and an unnamed person with inside knowledge, suggested by the logged use of access cards at controlled doors, entered separately at 21:12 and 21:13 and worked together inside. Mr Abiodun Castellanos reached the storeroom in the same entry sequence without a separately logged entry, was restrained by one collaborator while the other shoved him into the cabinet, and both collaborators left in the 21:31 opening. This requires entries and exits that the corridor log does not separately record.

In an alternative reading that deliberately takes the other side of a disputed clock, each conflict with that clock costs 8 points instead (inside the same cap of 30). This is a ranking heuristic over checkable facts, not a probability that the scenario is true.

supporting_facts.text: Two access cards were granted at the storeroom within about a minute and two people entered while the door then stayed closed, suggesting coordinated use of controlled access.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos reported a heated argument, a hard shove and hitting the cabinet, with blood on the cabinet edge and disturbance around the door.
Raised voices and a thud were recorded from the closed storeroom area before C-017 left at 21:31.

contradicted_points.text: CCTV describes only a C-017 person and a second C-041 person entering, and only Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito/C-017 leaving at 21:31; it does not record a separate entry or exit for Mr Abiodun Castellanos or a second collaborator leaving.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos described one man shoving him, not two people acting together or one restraining him.
Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito denied Mr Abiodun Castellanos was with him and denied touching him, weakening any account placing collaborators with the victim.
The identity of the C-041 card holder is not established by the statements, so the unnamed collaborator's identity remains open.
